summary: From a blank file you write a small workflow where a build job needs the test job, make a test fail on purpose and read its real exit code, and see how && closes the gate and how || true opens it again. Branch protection turns a red mark into a lock; it is a repository setting that this lesson did not test.
goal: M13: a gate from a blank file.

items.text: Draw the two jobs and the arrow before writing a line
Write the trigger, the name and the least permission
Write the test job and the build job with needs, and lint the file
Add a test that fails on purpose and read the last lines and the exit code of pytest
Put && between the tests and an echo, and run it with and without the broken test
Add || true, see the exit code of the line, and write what it would do on GitHub
Play the Gate Check game to the end and see your score
